signal.levels: first depth_levels validated levels on each side of the sealed or replayed book
signal.formula: B = sum(bid px x bid sz), A = sum(ask px x ask sz), total = B + A, I = (B - A) / total, spread_bps = 10000 x (best ask - best bid) / ((best ask + best bid) / 2). All comparisons use exact rational arithmetic; floats are for display only.
signal.qualifying: an observation qualifies long when I > entry_threshold and short when I < -entry_threshold (strict), with spread_bps <= max_spread_bps, total >= min_combined_depth_usd and total > 0. Equality to the threshold is neutral. A side with fewer than depth_levels levels does not qualify (insufficient_depth).
signal.eligibility: each confirming observation has event and first receipt at or before D, satisfies the contract time bounds and has a distinct source identity; the newest (crossing) observation has D - event <= max_snapshot_age_ms and D - receipt <= max_snapshot_age_ms
signal.episode: a maximal same-direction run of distinct qualifying observations after a proven boundary. A neutral observation, a spread or depth filter failure, the other direction, or any reset marker (epoch_start, subscribed, subscription_failed, disconnected, invalid_frame, conflict, out_of_order, clock_regression, silence, evidence_loss, depth_raised) ends it. A boundary is proven by a retained marker or a retained non-qualifying observation; if the window holds neither before the run, the result is evidence_truncated and entries hold.
signal.crossing: the Nth qualifying observation, N = confirmation_observations; crossing time = max(event, first receipt) of that observation
signal.deadline: the sole decision deadline is the smallest UTC whole second at or above the crossing time. The entry is emitted only if the episode is still the active valid run at D and its evidence is eligible. A break before D cancels the opportunity.
signal.consumption: the episode is consumed at its deadline whether a position is open, a risk limit blocks, a fill fails or the deadline is skipped. Later intervals return a consumed hold. A missed deadline never catches up.
signal.identity: episode identity = sha256 over contract, source key, specification hash, effective parameter JSON, boundary identity, direction and first qualifying observation identity; entry identity = sha256 over episode identity, crossing observation identity and deadline. The same interval and input always return the same decision and identity.
signal.diagnostics: every result records deadline, source/contract/specification hashes, episode and entry identity when defined, used observation identities, B, A, total, I, spread_bps, ages, confirmation count, state and reason
signal.failure_outcome: missing, malformed, stale, conflicting or incomplete book evidence gives signal 0 with a stable reason; invalid parameters are refused before any data is read

validation.min_combined_depth_usd: finite positive quote notional, at most 1000000000
validation.rules: booleans are not numbers; fractional integers, unknown keys, non-finite values and unsupported combinations are refused before data acquisition; Go requirement extraction and the Python registry mirror one validator

parameters.search_family: the full Cartesian product (972 variants); every attempted variant is kept in the study log
parameters.note: research seeds, not endorsed trading settings; the depth contract and the fixed values are never optimized

exit_and_risk.stop_owner: scalar stop_loss_atr_mult 1.0; ATR over the last 14 complete 1m bars with the simple method, frozen at the first confirmed entry fill; missing ATR prevents entry
exit_and_risk.bars_held: integer count of complete one-minute durations since the entry fill
exit_and_risk.no_other_owner: no close fallback, reversal close, trailing stop, scale-in, hedge or take-profit
exit_and_risk.pre_entry_stop_bound: entry refused when the stop distance times size exceeds 1% of current equity (refusal bound only)
exit_and_risk.portfolio_controls: 2% UTC daily realized-loss entry hold; 10% peak-equity drawdown entry latch; pause and unreadable portfolio marks hold new exposure; closes continue
exit_and_risk.protection_order: protection and risk exits apply before elective entries at a deadline
exit_and_risk.liquidation: isolated venue margin tiers from pinned metadata and the existing liquidation-stop clamp; unresolved stop ownership or nonpositive protection geometry is refused

latency.direct_owner_scenario: labeled separately with zero transport delay; never represents the shared consumer

execution.fill_book: the first distinct valid book with event and receipt strictly after D and both at or after D + settle + processing; an event at D cannot fill its own decision; recorded seal or decision availability, if later, raises the executable time
execution.depth_walk: buys walk asks in ascending price, sells walk bids in descending price; requested and available quantity are lot-floored; same-time intents share depth once in stable coin, strategy, identity order; actual weighted prices and fees are booked
execution.partial: one immediate-or-cancel attempt per entry identity; the remainder is cancelled; no resubmission
execution.minimums: entries below the pinned venue minimum notional are refused; a full reduce-only close uses the frozen venue remainder rule; no close exceeds held size; partial closes keep entry ATR and sizing geometry
execution.exits: time-stop and stop requests use later executable depth and stay pending while books are unreadable; no close is booked from missing depth

costs.spread: inside the walked bid/ask; no half spread is added
costs.funding: charged on held exposure under the right-closed hourly contract; pre-fee realized and net results are kept separate

execution.marks: markPx from recorded activeAssetCtx frames at their receipt time, for stops and liquidation
execution.unresolvable_order: a window where the event stream cannot resolve liquidation or stop/exit order is reported unsupported and inconclusive
execution.terminal_inventory: marked separately and never labeled a venue close; missing exit prices prevent net scoring
execution.replay_order: resets and timers apply before a same-time decision; books apply before a decision only when event and receipt are both at or before it; tie order is receipt time, source key, local sequence; funding and candles use their own availability times

comparator.entries: native mirrored entry columns through the registry; the explicit native close owner suppresses its open-fallback exits
comparator.opportunity: one per coin per closed candle; decision at the first UTC whole second when that candle is available
comparator.fill: no earlier than the next bar open and the first later latency-eligible executable book
comparator.identical: data eligibility, stops, time close, capital, fees, latency, lot and minimum rules, risk and portfolio limits, and the same event simulator

recording.storage: outside git; run and segment manifests and their hashes are committed with the study

data_plan.candles: 1m candleSnapshot captures every 24 hours during the recording through run_study.py capture-candles (72-hour requests); overlapping captures must agree on every closed minute
data_plan.venue: meta (size decimals, max leverage, margin tables) pinned at the start and end through run_study.py capture-venue; the two must agree for BTC and ETH
data_plan.funding: fundingHistory fetched after the recording for the full span and hash-pinned
data_plan.windows: whole UTC days from the first complete recorded day: first 60% training, next 20% validation, last 20% held-out, split into three chronological held-out blocks; UTC start-inclusive, end-exclusive bounds are written into the study manifest from the hash-pinned data bounds before scoring
data_plan.purge: five-minute position purge at each boundary, flat scored starts, unscored lookback prefixes

eligibility.eligible_day: a whole UTC day with book, mark and candle evidence for every decision opportunity of both coins except gaps covered by recorded markers, and funding for every hour
eligibility.opportunity_coverage: at least 99% of decision opportunities with full book, mark and candle evidence
eligibility.held_hour_coverage: 100% funding, cost and executable-exit coverage for every held hour
eligibility.integrity: a recording that the independent replay refuses (unclosed, dropped records, incomplete segment, replay mismatch) is invalid evidence

selection_rule: training selects the greatest net result among complete variants; ties choose the lexicographically smallest parameter JSON; validation freezes the selected variant and reports all variants; held-out values never change the choice

bootstrap.method: UTC-day block bootstrap of candidate-minus-comparator net equity change

pass_if_all: bootstrap lower bound of the paired improvement > 0
at least two of three held-out blocks with positive improvement
candidate maximum drawdown no worse than the comparator
selected variant net result > 0 at each processing stress (500 and 1000 ms)
net result > 0 for a majority of the selected variant's available one-axis neighbors
verdict.fail: a complete scored run that misses any pass requirement
verdict.inconclusive: insufficient evidence: fewer than 30 eligible days, fewer than three held-out blocks, fewer than 100 closed held-out positions in either arm, coverage below the gates, or missing cost, funding, mark or exit evidence
verdict.published: every attempted variant with net return, maximum drawdown, turnover, fees, funding, coin and direction concentration and independent position totals, including negative results and parameter neighbors
verdict.live_status: production_refused for every outcome; promotion needs a separate reviewed decision
